tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of KPP portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end
Conditional tenders will not be accepted
Tenderers are required to read the Bid Documents carefully before submission of their bid
Any discrepancies observed in the documents uploaded by the tenderer the tender shall liable to rejected
The Statutory taxes will be deducted as per prevailing government orders as may be modified from time to time
The Tenderer shall scan Original Workdone certificates / Turnover Statements and any other documents specified by the employer and attach the scanned file to the Bid
The Employer reserves the right to reject any or all Tenders without assigning any reason or what so ever

The bidder have to submit the registration certificates in regard of Registration certificate, ESI, PF and other statutory registration certificates pertaining to Vehicle services from the issuing authorities of concerned department
The earnest money deposit will be forfeited if the documents submitted by the tenderer found to be misleading/forged or fake
Financial turnover of previous years shall be given a weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of the 2026-27
Contractors must fulfil the conditions for the qualification of the tenderer and the special conditions of contract given in bid document uploaded

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Agency/Firm should have minimum 3 years experience in the field of providing Vehicle services. (Agency/ Firm needs to submit the Valid firm registration certificates.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Individual/firm/Company registration certificates by the competent authority

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Satisfactory completed, at least one similar Contract of Providing Vehicle services of total value not less than Rs.38.45 Lakhs. as prime Agency/ Firm in last five years (2021-22 to 2025-26) (To attach Experience/Completion Certificate issued by not below the rank of the Executive Engineer or Equivalent or Employer in case of Govt / Semi Govt. Authorities and General Manager in case of public sector Undertaking.

Satisfactory completed, similar Contracts of Providing Vehicle services of total 11 Nos of Vehicles for a period of one year as prime Agency/ Firm in any one year in last 5 years i.e., 2021-22 to 2025-26. (To attach Experience/Completion Certificate issued by not below the rank of the Executive Engineer or Equivalent or Employer in case of Govt/ Semi Govt. Authorities and General Manager in case of Public sector Undertaking.)

Provident fund (PF) Registration Certificate and recent continuous six months Provident fund (PF) remittance challans (Attach valid Registration Certificate of agency obtained from the issuing authorities and recent continuous six months PF remittance challans).

ESI department Registration Certificate and recent continuous six months ESI remittance challans (Attach valid Registration Certificate of agency obtained from the issuing authorities and recent continuous six months ESI remittance challans)
GST Registration Certificate (Attach valid Registration Certificate of agency obtained from the issuing authorities)

Achieved in at least two financial years in last five years (2021-22 to 2025-26) annual financial turnover of Rs. 76.91 lakhs. (Attach Certified balance sheet issued by the chartered accountant along with the turnover certificate with UDIN for the above-indicated years along with IT returns filed for the said years all to be uploaded with the technical bid).Attached are copies of financial statements (Auditors Report, Profit and Loss Statements, Balance Sheets, Form 240 of Sales Tax Returns / GST Annual Returns in the state of Karnataka & Relevant documents whichever is applicable in respective states, including all related notes and income statements) for the last FIVE Years,as indicated above, complying with the following conditions.1)All such documents reflect the financial situation of the Tenderer, and not sister or parent companies.2)Financial statements must be audited and certified by a certified Chartered Accountant (CA).3)Financial statements must be complete, including all notes to the financial statements.Financial statements must correspond to accounting periods already completed and audited (no statements for partial periods shall be requested or accepted).

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: All documents as per bid document uploaded

itemList.itemName: Monthly Hiring of AC Sedan Car with Driver( Hiring charges per vehicle per month for an AC sedan with a maximum usage of 2,500 km or 300 hours per month, including Sundays and public holidays. The rate shall be inclusive of driver salary, PF, ESI, income tax, fuel, road tax, registration, fitness certificate (FC), comprehensive insurance, servicing, repairs, maintenance, spare parts, and all other statutory expenses. Excluding GST).

Rate per Kilometre for Additional Usage AC Sedan with Driver (Applicable for usage beyond 2,500 km per month on a monthly hire basis with a driver, including Sundays and public holidays. The rate shall be inclusive of driver salary, PF, ESI, income tax, fuel, road tax, registration, fitness certificate (FC), comprehensive insurance, servicing, repairs, maintenance, spare parts, and all other statutory expenses. Excluding GST).
